lines.trans: This dish is made according to all rules.

examples.trans: This is the restaurant's signature dish.
We need a more objective assessment.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

жалко.gloss: feel sorry for; it's a pity

meanings.note: impersonal predicate (+ dative of experiencer, + accusative/genitive)

examples.trans: I just feel sorry for him.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.
I'm working with clients right now.
This is only for regular clients.
Somebody on the street will tell him.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
to carry, deliver something to a place

examples.text: Я сам отнесу блюдо в зал.
examples.trans: I will carry the dish into the dining room myself.
Take the documents to the boss.

отойти.gloss: to step back, to move away

meanings.en: to step aside, to move back

examples.trans: He stepped over to the window.
The critic gave a high rating to the restaurant.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: mostly the imperative: погоди! = wait!; ну, погоди! = just you wait!

получаться.gloss: to work out, to come out

meanings.note: не получается = it isn't working, I can't (manage it)

meanings.en: to be liked, to make a good impression
meanings.note: person who likes is in the dative

examples.text: Синеозерск понравился в Москве больше других мест.
examples.trans: In Moscow they liked Sineozersk more than other places.

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look
to have to, be forced to (impersonal: приходится)

examples.trans: One has to do everything oneself.
She has to work a lot.

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build
работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: The dish is made according to the rules.
This is an item made by a master's hands.
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

meanings.note: с другой стороны = on the other hand

examples.trans: On the other hand, it's interesting.
The shop is on that side.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Что у нас сегодня на ужин?
examples.trans: What do we have for dinner today?

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
